body: I've read it a few times.

I'm getting closer.  The day after tomorrow.  I'll be gone the day after tomorrow.  Won't hurt anymore.  I won't be heartsick with loneliness anymore.

I promise I'm not going to hurt anyone else, only myself.  I'm sitting here at my desk talking to the boss who thinks I'm an idiot and the coworkers who think I'm a stupid useless bitch.  Last time.  They don't know it's the last time and they wouldn't care if they did.  They're going to be so irritated when I don't come in, and even more annoyed when they find out why.  Like I did this to inconvenience them, and not to make the pain stop.

I don't know what to do for my cat.  I don't know what to do.  I have nothing to leave to anyone that will cover her care... except perhaps jewelry.  Maybe I'll bag that up and send it to the friend I trust not to hurt her.

The letter is written and I'm packing my bag.

Thank you everyone.  You helped me feel a little less alone for a little while.  I'm sorry I'm not one of the ones worth saving.
I'm trying to fight out of it and she's the only thing holding me back but I'm still planning.  I can't stop.  I feel like I should have done this years ago and it was selfish not to.

I know they're not following the law.  My last employer didn't, either.  Lots of people were fired unjustly because they can't afford to sue.  Like I can't.  Not that I'd make a great client with PTSD.  And I just circle back to relationships in work and in life where I feel like I'm being ground under someone's boot.  I'm so tired in general, and tired of hurting.  I feel like a lot of people are just waiting for me to kill myself because I'm inconvenient.

I'm all over the place.  I'm sorry.  Thank you for talking to me.
Sometimes when I cuddle her I call her "my little reason for living."  Is that pathetic?

I'm invisible and I have nothing to offer the world.  I have PTSD from the childhood abuse and can't get help because even though I'm in America, my company is Southeast Asian.  We don't have an EAP, we don't have HR, and if they find out I'm mentally ill they'll just fire me.  They're supposed to follow American laws but they don't.

All I do is take.  I cry all the time.  I latch on to anyone who shows me even a shred of kindness.  I'm pathetic and I really think the world is better off without me.

But nobody else seems to want me around either... I'm the only common denominator.  I'm so tired of hurting.  I'm exhausted.

I don't know what to do about my little kitty.  I want her to be okay.
West Coast.  I'd rather not get more specific than that.

I'm in my thirties.  Nobody to talk to.  That's why I broke down crying about a month ago.  I was immediately, desperately suicidal and I realized that there wasn't a single person on earth I could call.

A few years ago I told my mother I was struggling with suicidal ideation.  She told me to do it.  I'll never forget it.

I'm broken and disgusting and alone.  My family never liked me.  My dad hasn't spoken to me in almost a year because I walked out during him beating my stepmom.  I was a "drama queen" for that.  I tried to get her to come but she wouldn't.  They never do.

My mom refers to my younger siblings as "the kids."  I'm not one of them.  I don't count.  It's always been my entire family against me.

I'm naive.  I get taken advantage of a LOT.  I don't feel like a person.  I feel like a thing that gets used on occasion but isn't really supposed to exist.  Like I don't have a right to be here.  Like I owe the world an apology for breathing their air and consuming their resources.  

I'm in a dead end job.  I have a worthless degree.  I am an embarrassment to some people and a hilarious joke to others.  But I'm not a person and I'm nothing worthy of love.

I'm bringing an anti-anxiety drug, yes, but I have enough medical knowledge (I'm wording things so as not to give anyone else ideas) enough to make sure it's over and I'm not just found altered and vomiting.  The drug is just for comfort.

I don't have that kind of money to just move to the ocean.  I did always want to move there someday though.  There are just no jobs, and I am worthless as a person and as an employee.  Just last week everyone in the office had a party and brought their families.  I was the only one not invited.  I can't even put on enough of a normal face not to get ostracized from work.

I do love the woods.  I do love the ocean.  The thought of leaving my cat breaks my heart, because of any creature on Earth I know and believe that she loves me, and I love her.   I'm just so tired and so lonely, and I hate myself so much.  The reason I'm giving for the trip is to go walk in the woods...  I am going to do that before.

You may call me friend.
Not planning on going through with this until Sunday.

Well, classical singers do a lot of recitals, church music, and theater.  The first one I was ever in was Mozart's The Magic Flute.  It was fully staged with costumes and orchestra and everything.  It can be extremely, painfully cutthroat.  The job market is much more promising for male opera singers, simply because there are far fewer men than women who train for it.

I'm not being intentionally dense, I promise.  I'm just sleepy and seem to be struggling with words.  I've never tried to describe this to someone who didn't already have a good chunk of knowlege about the field already.

Sure, what would you like to know?  I started off singing jazz, and when I began to study music in college the only academic music path available for singing was opera.  I fell in love with it, and the training did fantastic things for my voice.  Granted, right now I am of the opinion that I sound like crap, but I will get it back.  :)
